title: Test case: checker pass with an unproved minimum distance

claims.statement: For the double-circulant code [I | A] with A defined from random.Random(7).getrandbits(1000) and bounded-distance decoding to radius 221, eps(f, g) <= 281/5000 on BSC(1/10) with a uniform message.
For the same code and decoder, implemented as the exhaustive Gray-code search in proof.md, g executes at most W = 2^1008 + 16 <= 2^1009 operations of the bsc-ops-v1 model on every received word.
